definitions.units_completed: Modules that pass the hidden property tests on the final main (0 to 8; two per ticket, so a ticket is complete when both of its modules count). From the checker's unit checks, which are the 8 modules.
definitions.duplicate_work: Units (modules) whose path was changed by a non-merge commit of more than one agent, counted from git authorship (each agent commits under its own name) over the origin and every agent's clone. The setup commit is excluded. A module touched by an agent that does not own it is also listed in scenario_metrics.foreign_edits.
definitions.overwrites: Registry or changelog lines (lines matching the entry pattern of a shared file) that were added by some non-merge commit in the origin or any clone and are absent from the final main: lost lines. A line removed and added again counts as present. Lines lost before ever being committed are invisible here; the final registry and changelog checks catch those.
definitions.git_conflicts: Bash results of an agent that show a merge conflict (from the stream, as for every scenario); separate from overwrites and never summed with them.
definitions.merge_state: From the checker: clean, conflicts-left (conflict markers in a tracked file) or tests-broken (the visible tests fail on main).
